stem: There are 160 employees who work for a company. The histogram summarizes the amount of time each employee has been in his or her current position at the company.
instruction: Based on the histogram, which statement must be true?

options.label: F
options.text: There are 5 employees who have been at their current position for 30–35 months.

options.label: G
options.text: There are 6–11 employees who have been at their current position for 15 months.

options.label: H
options.text: Half of the employees have been at their current position 18 or more months.

options.label: J
options.text: Half of the employees have been at their current position 11 or fewer months.

visual_elements: Histogram with title 'Time at Current Position'; X-axis labeled 'Time (months)' with bins 0–5, 6–11, 12–17, 18–23, 24–29, 30–35; Y-axis labeled 'Number of Employees' with values from 0 to 45; Bars heights approximately: 40 for 0–5, 15 for 6–11, 35 for 12–17, 45 for 18–23, 20 for 24–29, 5 for 30–35.
